grid_sensitivity.note: window inside the start-up cycle: compares the start-up transient on both grids, not the cycle-averaged eta_s

summary: Every point run is listed; none is fitted or selected. Compare eta_s_strip against alpha_eff_amplitude_deg. Points with complete=false are partial and say how many cycles they hold. For the design-kinematics points eta_s_per_cycle gives each averaged cycle; periodic_converged is false when two cycles differ by more than 0.1 in eta_s (threshold set when these results were read, stated here so it can be judged), and then eta_s_strip is a two-cycle mean, not a settled value.
section: E387 coordinates (the design's 'e387-film' wing: film on both faces over E387 ribs). The 2 mm rod leading edge is not modelled separately: E387's own nose is used.
method: OpenFOAM 13, kOmegaSSTLM, Tu 0.1%, 2D C-grid (V7 settings), whole mesh in solid-body harmonic plunge h = h0 sin(omega t), consistent PIMPLE dt 0.0025 c/U scaled with the first-cell height, the first cycle discarded as start-up and every later whole cycle averaged (cycles_averaged per point).

definitions.cc: chordwise force coefficient towards the leading edge, -Fx/(q c span), pressure plus viscous
definitions.ideal_suction: Garrick mean LE suction of a flat plate in pure plunge: pi |C(k)|^2 (k h0/b)^2, k = omega b/U
definitions.eta_s: (mean cc - cc_steady(alpha0)) / ideal_suction; cc_steady = Cl sin a0 - Cd cos a0 at the same Re, a0, grid
definitions.eta_s_literal: (mean cc + Cd_steady(alpha0)) / ideal_suction, the protocol's wording
definitions.eta_s_strip: mean(cc + Cd_f cos a) / mean(CL sin a) over the last two cycles: the eta that makes strip.js's realised chordwise force, eta L sin a - D_f cos a, match the measured cycle mean; a is the instantaneous effective angle from the plunge velocity, CL the measured lift normal to the relative wind, Cd_f the lowest converged V7 Cd at that Re (strip.js's polar minimum drag). This is the form to use in strip.js.
